description: ktor-kronos, JetBrains Ktor on the JVM with the kron engine (ktor-server-kron, in the MDA2AV/ktor fork) instead of Netty or CIO. kron is the Kotlin port of the ioxide io_uring runtime: one reactor per core, each pinned to its CPU and owning its ring and its share of the SO_REUSEPORT listeners; multishot accept and recv into provided buffer rings, the kernel and BoringSSL reached through the FFM API on JDK 25. Requests are parsed by Glyph11, the hardened HTTP/1.1 parser, and run through Ktor's own pipeline - routing, plugins, call.receive and call.respond - on the reactor that accepted the connection, with no thread pool in between. Responses to pipelined requests leave in one send. delay() is an IORING_OP_TIMEOUT on the reactor's ring. The routes are the ktor entry's, answered the same way: JSON through Ktor's ContentNegotiation with kotlinx.serialization, gzipped by Ktor's Compression plugin, and Ktor's own WebSockets. TLS on :8081 is the engine's own connector on kron's BoringSSL. The engine passes Ktor's own engine suites (HttpServerCommonTestSuite, WebSocketEngineSuite).
